name: Garnerprop
description: Reach past the guard and set the hook on the target's arm, ready to draw it across.

name: Wild Harvest
description: Slice the fine forward edge across the inside of the wrist with a quick turn of the hand.

name: Rooted Sickletang
description: Brace the haft against the forearm and rotate the body to let a blow slide off the wood.

name: Springing Glean
description: Slide a short pace forward on a pulse of qi into the legs, closing without a telegraphed step.

name: Stern Reapedge
description: Set the hook on the target's belt, draw them onto the blade and slice across the stomach in the same pull.

name: Rigid Tipcurve
description: Hook an incoming blade at its guard and wrench it aside with a half turn of the wrist and qi.

name: Rough Hookblade
description: Snag a hanging cord on the hook and cut it with a short yank of the blade.

name: Gripping Handleknob
description: Loop the hook over a limb as if tying twine and pull the knot tight toward the body.

name: Brutal Bowbelly
description: Rake the toothed edge sideways down the target's flank as you slip past on the outside.

name: Armored Crookspine
description: Meet a descending cut with the thick spine of the blade and let it ring off.

name: Strawglide
description: Drop the hips and take one quick pace along the ground to change the distance.

name: Tethering Greenedge
description: Flick the tip under a shield strap or quiver cord and cut it so the burden falls away.

name: Stook Prop
description: Sweep the hook around both ankles of a standing target and hold qi in it to pin their feet.

name: Armored Handleknob
description: Press the blade's edge against an incoming shaft and lean in to stop its travel.

name: Grasshasp
description: Ripple the hooked tip along the inside of the target's guard to break the line of their grip.

name: Stalwart Inwardbelly
description: Raise the haft overhead to catch a falling blow and shed it down the wood to the side.

name: Bladeswat
description: Chop the blade down on the opponent's wrist with only a flick of forearm and elbow.

name: Binding Greenedge
description: Reverse the blade, tuck the hook behind the opponent's elbow and pin the arm against the ribs.

name: Coasting Glean
description: Retreat one short pace and return to guard in time to meet the follow-up strike.

name: Clutching Stook
description: Spiral the blade over an enemy's thrust, catch their wrist in the hook and pull them onto a cut.

name: Strawbarrier
description: Catch the enemy's blade in the hook and shear down its length, striking the gripping hand.

name: Brisk Sicklegrip
description: Strike backhand along a wide arc so the outer part of the edge bites the target.

name: Reap Prop
description: Hook one wrist, then the other with the free hand's grip on the haft, and lock them together.

name: Rugged Garner
description: Shove with the flat of the blade and the shoulder to push the target back like a heavy bundle.

name: Pirouetting Sicklegrip
description: Hop from one raised ridge or stone to the next so the blade stays level while the feet shift.

name: Swift Bowbelly
description: Draw the teeth through the target's gear in a long slow stroke with qi held along the edge.

name: Swift Crookspine
description: Cut from a deep crouch at the shins and rise straight back into guard.

name: Ducking Tipcurve
description: Weave between enemies as if between rows, cutting each in passing without ever halting the stride.

name: Acrid Sickletang
description: Carry qi along the curve and sweep a wide arc that cuts everything within the blade's reach.

name: Tethering Harvest
description: Hook a retreating opponent's shoulder or collar and pull them back off their line of flight.

name: Weighty Garner
description: Anchor the rear heel and pull the hooked limb across the body to topple the target.

name: Discord Sheave
description: Twist the hook sharply as if snapping a stalk and wrest the enemy's grip out of line.

name: Inwardbelly Hammerfall
description: Skim the hooked tip forward across the surface of the guard and scrape along the arm.

name: Sleet Inwardbelly
description: Let the blade hang point down before the body and take a low strike on its curve.

name: Moment Reap
description: Slap the rounded back of the blade against the enemy's hand to stall a reaching grab.

name: Gleamstraw
description: Flick the point into an unguarded pit of the arm, as a weeder flicks out a root.

name: Brawn Crookspine
description: Walk with the quiet heel-first pace of a row-walker so the feet make no sound and no stumble.

name: Sleetreap
description: Roll the hook over the top of the enemy's guard and pull the edge down across the shoulder.

name: Strawscreen
description: Spin the haft through the hand in a fast turn and break an overhead strike apart with the wood.

name: Garner Swat
description: Gather qi along the curve over several breaths, then pull the edge through the target in one slice.

name: Lassoing Sicklegrip
description: Hook the cuff of the opponent's sleeve and pull it to spoil the draw of the weapon beneath.

name: Crimson Sheave
description: Scrape the teeth along the opponent's shin as they step forward to slow the advance.

name: Sleetstraw
description: Cross the haft over the blade's base to make a bar that holds against a downward cut.

name: Handleknob Scorer
description: Cut from the elbow in a close arc at the inside of the opponent's thigh.

name: Slinking Reapedge
description: Offset the lead foot sideways and slide onto a line where the enemy cannot easily strike.

name: Gallstraw
description: Lift the hooked tip to neck height as a warning and force the enemy to jerk their head back.

name: Sprigsheave
description: Catch the enemy's weapon in the hook and draw it in against the body with sustained qi.

name: Swift Tipcurve
description: Drop under a swing and sweep the edge across the legs while the haft pushes the weapon over you.

name: Honedreap
description: Pull the blade straight back through a target's torso from the inside of the curve.

name: Stampreap
description: Reach the tip around the enemy's guard and hook the back of their hand.

name: Haze Bowbelly
description: Turn the palm over so the blade face meets and redirects a thrust past the ribs.

name: Bold Harvest
description: Dig the point into a joint gap in armor with a sharp thrust and quick retraction.

name: Coasting Sickletang
description: Hop backward over a furrow or low obstacle to break the opponent's pursuit.

name: Sleet Greenedge
description: Hook the wrist and turn it outward until the enemy's own weapon points away from you.

name: Brawn Sheave
description: Reach over a hedge, barrel or raised shield with the curve and slice the exposed hand behind it.

name: Grassswat
description: Chop down with the heavy blade's own weight and pull back at the moment of impact.

name: Rude Reapedge
description: Chop overhand with the toothed edge so it bites and holds in leather or wood.

name: Levering Stook
description: Hook the crook of the handle under the opponent's belt and tug them half a step in.

name: Sleetblade
description: Plant the heavy blade across the front and take a blow without letting the haft shift.

name: Rillreap
description: Drag the back foot through to keep the weight low and the heavy blade steady.

name: Momentstook
description: Knock the blunt back of the heavy blade into the ribs to drive the breath out.

name: Gall Reap
description: Whip the heavy hook under the crossguard and tear the weapon out of the opponent's hand.

name: Staticstraw
description: Back the heavy hook cut with qi in the forearm and drag the edge deep through the target.

name: Hazegrass
description: Press the enemy's weapon down with the hooked edge and drag it aside as you step inside.
